dw.title: Archive Discover Weekly
dw.description-text: Copies the current Discover Weekly into a playlist named after the calendar week and files it into "{{folder}}".
dw.description: Archived from {{source}} by Spotify Library Manager.

dw.source-empty: The source playlist contains no playable tracks.

limitations.title: Two things the Spotify API cannot do
limitations.folders: Spotify offers no public endpoints for playlist folders or the sidebar order. Folders and the custom order in this app are therefore stored locally in your browser and are not visible in the Spotify clients.
limitations.dw: Since late 2024 algorithmic playlists such as Discover Weekly are only accessible to apps with an approved quota extension. If the archive run reports a missing source, point it at a mirror playlist of your own in the settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dw-source-hint: Optional override, used when Discover Weekly is not readable through the API.

sidebar.title: Your library
sidebar.root-dropzone: Drop here to move to the top level

playlist.row-tooltip: Click for other releases of this track, drag into the assistant
playlist.apply-order-tooltip: Write the current sort order back to Spotify

playlist.order-failed-restorable: The order write failed and the playlist may be incomplete. Restore the snapshot from the home view.

variants.title: Other releases
variants.explainer: Singles, albums, remasters and compilations of this track. Green chips carry an exact date, yellow only a month, gray only a year. Replacing keeps the position in the playlist.

variants.replaced: Replaced, the release date is now {{date}}.
variants.replace-failed: The track could not be replaced.
variants.replace-failed-restorable: The track could not be replaced. If the playlist looks wrong, restore the snapshot from the home view.

backup.title: Backup and recovery
backup.description: A snapshot of the affected playlists is taken automatically before every write that changes them. Download a full backup as well, since the folder tree only lives in this browser.
backup.download-failed: The backup could not be created.
backup.file-invalid: That file is not a backup of this app.
backup.preview-failed: The comparison with your live library failed.
backup.restore-tooltip: Write this snapshot back to Spotify
backup.save-tooltip: Save this snapshot as a file
backup.restored-skipped-local: {{count}} local files could not be re-added by the API.
backup.automatic-hint: The last 20 snapshots are kept in this browser. Save the ones that matter as a file.
backup.automatic-empty: No snapshots yet, they appear after the first write.

confirm.body: "{{label}}" will be written back to Spotify. Playlists marked as differing are overwritten with the backed-up order.
confirm.note: A snapshot of the current state is taken first, so this restore can itself be undone. Local files cannot be re-added, and restored tracks count as added today.

delete.body: The snapshot "{{label}}" will be removed. This does not touch Spotify.
